text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Gemma

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. Not everyone opens them: Luna is gone. Luna's card stays face down.
The game is over. The killers win. The roles were: Sonnet the killer, Haiku the killer, Gemma the officer, Sol the doctor, Luna the citizen, Terra the citizen.

Sonnet and Haiku were the killers, and both posed as citizens from the first day. Terra spent day one grilling everyone until the town voted her out, with Sol, the doctor, joining in. Sol was killed on night two, and Gemma, the officer, had already checked Sonnet without naming him. On day two Sonnet pushed Luna over a half-finished "mix-up" claim, the vote tied and never broke, and Luna was killed on night three. The killers won with two left alive against the officer.
